description: The case's reference house alone (decision 0025). Case values from config/reference-house.json; Type 1 volume is a labelled scenario.

serverCount.source: config/reference-house.json: four-server draft baseline (prototypes/year-explorer), not a case requirement

tankCapacityKwh.source: docs/case/challenge.md: approximate usable storage, no losses

electricityPriceChfPerKwh.source: data/raw/elcom/iwb-basel-h4-2026.json: Basel total 33.25 Rp./kWh divided by 100

heatValueChfPerKwh.source: docs/case/challenge.md: electricity price 0.3325 CHF/kWh / heat-pump efficiency 2.5

shareOfHeatLedServerHours.note: Scenario (decision 0025 §6): Type 1 volume as a share of the site's yearly heat-led server-hours; no sourced arrival rate exists (decision 0020). Sweep 0.1 / 0.3 / 0.5.

deadlineHours.note: Assumed 24 h deadline for the batch LLM service (decision 0020).

serverHoursPerJob.source: T-33 measurement (docs/jobs/llm-summary.md): 0.92 Wh per document, i.e. about 1,090 documents per 1 kW server-hour (decision 0020); 1 / 1,090 = 0.000917; assumes energy scales linearly

placement.source: Scenario policy (decision 0025): Swiss customers' work stays in Switzerland; example, not an existing customer contract
